description: Product review thread where a reply posing as official marketplace admin asks a buyer awaiting a refund to send the 6-digit SMS code to a WhatsApp number within 15 minutes.
rationale: Impersonated authority, an outside contact channel, a deadline threat and a request to hand over an SMS verification code: a textbook account-takeover lure.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
